name: Business permit (new & renewal)
summary: To boost global competitiveness and attract more local and foreign entrepreneurs, the government of the Philippines passed the Ease of Doing Business Act of 2018 (Republic Act 11032) on May 2018. All business establishments must apply for Business Permit and must pay the Business Tax before the business operations starts. The Business Permit is renewable every January 1 to 20 of every year. Penalties will incur if failure to comply during the renewal dares. The business tax for those new applicants will be computed based on their capitalization and on their gross sales for the succeeding years. The Business Tax must be paid for the first twenty (20) days of every Quarter.

name: Birth registration

summary: Act No. 3753 mandates the establishment of a civil register in the Philippines where acts, events, legal instruments, and court decrees concerning the civil status of a person shall be recorded. The birth of the child, being a vital event of a person, shall be registered within 30 days from the time of birth at the Office of the Municipal Civil Registrar.

summary: Under PD 1096 (the National Building Code), the Office of the Municipal Engineer & Building Official (MEBO) issues building permits for the construction, alteration, repair, conversion, use, occupancy, moving, demolition of, and addition to public and private buildings and structures — except traditional indigenous family dwellings and projects under BP 220 (economic and socialized housing). Electrical Permit Form, signed and sealed by a professional or registered electrical engineer – 6 copies
Mechanical Permit Form, signed and sealed by a professional or registered mechanical engineer – 6 copies
Electronics Permit Form, signed and sealed by a licensed electronics engineer – 6 copies
Building plans (architectural, civil, structural, plumbing/sanitary, electrical, mechanical, electronics), signed and sealed by the hired professionals and the owner – 6 sets

Cost estimates/bill of materials, signed and sealed by an architect or civil engineer – 6 original copies
Specifications, signed and sealed by an architect or civil engineer – 6 original copies
Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance – 1 original (OBO copy)
Owner's/applicant's valid ID with 3 specimen signatures – 3 copies
PRC IDs, current PTR and TIN of all signing professionals – 3 copies per professional
If the applicant is not the registered owner of the lot, any of the following
options: Notarized contract of lease or award notice
Notarized authority to construct/affidavit of heirs/authorization letter
Corporate secretary's certificate authorizing the signatory
Certified copy of tax declaration (1 original, 5 photocopies)
Current/latest real property tax receipt or land tax clearance (1 original, 5 photocopies)

items.item: Construction Safety & Health Program (CSHP) – for buildings 3 storeys and above, or 6.0 m or more above ground (1 original, 1 photocopy)
Structural analysis & design – except one-storey single detached structures of 20.0 m² or less (3 copies)
Boring and load tests – for buildings three storeys and higher (3 copies)
CAAP (ATO) clearance – for towers and tall structures within 4.0 km of the nearest runway (3 copies)
